所有残存的生物人口变成唯心主义。

向[This.GetName]添加神之光修正，持续10年：

label.en:
Any Mechanical, Machine, or Hive-Minded  Pops are destroyed by the psionic resonance.

All remaining  Biological Pops become Spiritualist.

Adds the Divine Light modifier to [This.GetName] for 10 years:
Spiritualist Ethics Attraction: +999%.
